S1.desc: D1 G + Phase I (G1, G2, G3, existing.extxyz non-d0 kinds: G3L / Part B / V conformers)

S2.desc: Nurion TS-near (FT-cap tier 2: nur_ts_final or nur_ TS kind within 0.3 A of the label TS)

S4.desc: D0 (D0G1 / D0G2 / D0G3 + Phase I d0_* kinds = d1_validation runs)

definitions.rel_pair: |(E_a - E_b)_recomputed - (E_a - E_b)_stored| x 627.509 (kcal/mol), a / b = same reaction or molecule, same composition
definitions.force: |F_recomputed - REF_forces| per Cartesian component, eV/A -> kcal/mol/A (x 23.0605); MAE over all components of the source's structures (= the FT-1 force-MAE definition)

test_set.definition: fold-0 test pairs = analysis/d1_pair/results/S_folds.csv fold_T1 == 0; test reactions = their a_rxn and b_rxn

identity.smiles: RDKit canonical SMILES of each reactant of the label rxn_smiles, atom maps and stereo removed, sorted pair
identity.isomeric: the same WITH stereo: RDKit isomeric canonical SMILES (default) and standard InChI with stereo layers of each reactant; for geometry hits, the fragments' bond orders from rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBondOrders (charge 0, charged fragments allowed) and stereo from the 3D coordinates -> stereo InChI
identity.inchi: gen_d0.pair_ident (decision D0-ident: standard InChI of the map- and stereo-free molecule; resonance / charge placement invariant)
identity.geometry: independent of the tags: rdDetermineBonds.DetermineConnectivity of the stored geometry (covalent radii x 1.3) -> fragments -> element graph with explicit H, all bonds single; a 2-fragment structure is compared with the test reactant pairs, a 1-fragment structure with the test products (reaction rows) or the test reactants (molecule rows)
identity.row_tags: D1 rows: rxn_ids -> labels_d1_cr2 rxn_smiles (manifest for non-targets); D0 rows: d0_id (struct id d0g1_/d0g2_/d0g3_<rid>, Phase I group D0-<rid>) -> Coley full_dataset.csv rxn_smiles (labels_all.json has no SMILES); Nurion rows: job (struct id N:<job>:...) -> d1_manifest.csv rxn_smiles; Phase I d1_validation D1-design groups -> $D1VAL jobs label.json

cross_fold_stereo_siblings.note: D1 targets (all 9,266) whose stereo-free reactant pair occurs in more than one T1 fold (e.g. (E)- vs (Z)-2-butene cores AppE / AppZ): S_folds assigns folds by core, so stereo siblings can sit in different folds

molecule_overlap.note: molecule rows whose geometry graph equals a reactant of a fold-0 test reaction (reported separately, not part of the reaction-pair rule)

product_overlap.note: product-graph matches (1-fragment reaction rows or product optimisations) with a fold-0 test reaction product (reported separately)

precision.trained_model: float32: AIMNet2Base._prepare_dtype casts coord / charge to the default dtype at import (float32); finetune.aim_predict and mlts_bridge.AIMNet2Dense pass float32 coordinates; training batches float32; the export doubles only the atomic shifts
evaluated: float32 in the full model (forward hooks, dense all-pairs d_ij from the AEV)

detail.module: aimnet.modules.DFTD3 of the trained model (finetune.aim_build(.., d3='label') on the FTpilot_AIMNet2_0 best checkpoint): model.outputs.dftd3
detail.three_body: none in aimnet DFTD3 ('BJ dumping, C6 and C8 terms, without 3-body term'); ORCA D3BJ prints E6 + E8 only; simple-dftd3 with s9 = 0

precision.trained_model: float32: AIMNet2Base._prepare_dtype casts coord / charge to the default dtype at import (float32); finetune.aim_predict and mlts_bridge.AIMNet2Dense pass float32 coordinates; training batches float32; the export doubles only the atomic shifts
evaluated: float32 in the full model (forward hooks, dense all-pairs d_ij from the AEV)

detail.orca_reference: label-level EnGrad (verify_data orca): 'Edisp/kcal,au:' (Eh, 12 decimals) and the 'DISPERSION GRADIENT' block (Eh/bohr, 9 decimals); ORCA 6.1.1 DFTD3 V3.1 Rev 1
detail.pkg_reference: simple-dftd3 python 1.5.0, RationalDampingParam(B3LYP: s6 1, s8 1.9889, a1 0.3981, a2 4.4211, s9 0); pkg_cut31 = DFTD3 3.1 cutoffs (disp2 sqrt(9000), cn 40 bohr; the H-0 setting), pkg_default = package defaults
detail.unit_note: AIMNet2 energies eV -> Eh with aimnet.constants.Hartree (27.211386024); gradients dE/dx (eV/A) x Bohr / Hartree

model.which: best checkpoint (pilot still training: no finished export)

definitions.ts_near: TS-near (FT-1) = kind ts_near / ts_imag / ts_label / d0_ts_near / d0_ts_imag / d0_ts_label / d0_ts_grad, or kind ts_path / ts_final / g2_path / ts_final_g2 / al_ts / d0_g2_path / d0_ts_final_g2 / nur_ts_path / nur_ts_final / nur_tsguess_opt / nur_path / nur_neb / nur_fwd_bwd with dform_label_A <= 0.3 A (max over the two forming bonds of |d - d_label|, label TS + formed_pairs_ts; computed here for single-D1-reaction records without one; D0 records carry it from gen_dft collect --d0, against the D0 label TS; Nurion target-job records from inv_nurion scan, against the label TS). D0 rows without D1 rxn_ids are train-only, so the D0 kinds change only the train n_ts_near count, never an FT-1 metric (Phase I d0_ts_path / d0_ts_final are therefore not added). nur_x_* (non-target jobs) are never TS-near: no rxn_ids, and their dform_own_A is against their own TS, not a label TS. nur_ts_final is TS-near only within 0.3 A (as Phase I ts_final; N_report 11-04: 51 of 6,740 are farther), although tier 2 of FT-cap takes it always.
definitions.rel_e: within-reaction relative energy: structures of one reaction (single rxn_id) and one composition, E - mean(E) of the group (groups of >= 2), MAE over structures; primary on TS-near structures, also on all single-reaction structures. MACE uses interaction_energy (no float32 E0 quantisation).
definitions.force_mae: mean |F_pred - F_ref| over Cartesian components, kcal/mol/A
definitions.abs_e_mae: mean |E_pred - E_ref| per structure (absolute label-level energy), kcal/mol

d0_holdout_ts.note: gen_D0G1 TS-near rows of the D0 holdout reactions (d0_holdout.csv, eval + sibling roles; never in any FT split, FT-d0hold); relative energies grouped by d0_id

ft1_by_source.note_S4: fold0 valid / test contain no D0 rows (D0 = train only, DECISIONS FT-d0); S4 is measured on the D0 holdout TS rows instead

optimizer.engine: ORCA 6.1.1 `! ExtOpt OptTS` via mlts_bridge.optimize_ts (MLTS server on the job's GPU + mlts_client as ProgExt); ts_geom.py run = FT-2 / X
optimizer.start_hessian: MLIP Hessian written as .hess -> %geom InHess Read (AIMNet2: central differences of dense AIMNet2 forces, h = 2e-3 A, batched)
optimizer.recalc: analytic:30 (new MLIP Hessian every 30 cycles = a new segment)
optimizer.sella: not used in FT-2; only the C-1 (ii) reference optimiser (tests_c1.sella_ts)

model.which: best checkpoint exported by finetune.export_aimnet into $MLT/audit/models

optimizer.note: pass_production: ORCA (D1 block, NormalOpt) vs Sella (fmax 1e-3 eV/A) within 0.005 A for all 5. A miss is re-run with both optimisers tight (ORCA VeryTightOpt, Sella fmax 1e-4 eV/A): on a flat PES the NormalOpt stopping point can move ~0.01 A at < 0.01 kcal/mol. pass = every row within 0.005 A at production or tight settings. Non-convergence of a zero-shot model fails both.

c1_rerun_finetuned.note: tests_c1.t_optimizer called in-process (results/C1_tests.json is not modified): ORCA `ExtOpt OptTS` (production: D1 block, NormalOpt) vs Sella (order 1, MLIP Hessian, fmax 1e-3 eV/A) from the 5 C1_pick label TSs; a miss is re-run tight; pass = all 5 within 0.005 A
